description: Ministry of Woman, Child Affairs and Social Empowerment - Adoption of Children Ordinance (Chapter 61)
categorisation: This gazette contains a regulation made by the Minister under the Adoption of Children Ordinance, which constitutes a legal/regulatory matter. While it mentions a minister's name (Ranil Wickremesinghe), it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes.
